export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v27.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v27.description: Shows how to bind a PDF containing form fields and export all field values to a JSON file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form's ExportJson method.

import-json-field-values-into-pdf-form.title: Import JSON Field Values into PDF Form
import-json-field-values-into-pdf-form.description: Shows how to bind an existing PDF, import form field values from a JSON file using ImportJson, and save the updated PDF.

extract-choice-field-options-to-text.title: Extract Choice Field Options from PDF to Text File
extract-choice-field-options-to-text.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, locate a choice (ComboBox/ListBox) field named "ColorChoice", retrieve all its option values, and write them line‑by‑line to a text file.

read-selected-radio-button-save-to-text.title: Read Selected Radio Button from PDF Form and Save to Text
read-selected-radio-button-save-to-text.description: Shows how to bind a PDF form, get the current selection of a radio button group, and write the value to a text file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

export-import-pdf-form-data-xml.title: Export and Re-Import PDF Form Data via XML (Round-Trip)
export-import-pdf-form-data-xml.description: Shows how to bind a PDF to the Form facade, export its form fields to an XML file, import the same XML back into the form, and save the resulting PDF.

extract-options-from-pdf-form-field.title: Extract Options from a PDF Form Field
extract-options-from-pdf-form-field.description: Loads a PDF, finds a combo box or list box field named "Question1", retrieves all selectable options, and writes them to a text file.

read-pdf-form-field-value__v2.title: Read PDF Form Field Value and Save to Text File
read-pdf-form-field-value__v2.description: Shows how to bind a PDF form with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, get the current value of a specific field, and write that value to a text file.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v28.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON using Aspose.Pdf.Facades
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v28.description: Demonstrates how to bind a PDF form, import field values from an XML file, and export the populated fields to a pretty‑printed JSON file using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form class.

extract-pdf-form-options.title: Extract List/Combo Box Options from a PDF Form
extract-pdf-form-options.description: Loads a PDF form, locates a list or combo box field named SurveyQ, retrieves all selectable options, and writes them to a text file.

read-current-option-of-pdf-form-field.title: Read Current Option of a PDF Form Field and Save to Text
read-current-option-of-pdf-form-field.description: Shows how to bind a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form, retrieve the selected option of a specific form field, and write the value to a text file.

extract-radio-button-option-groups.title: Extract Radio Button Option Groups from PDF
extract-radio-button-option-groups.description: Loads a PDF, enumerates all radio‑button option fields, groups them by their field name, and writes each option's name and value to a text file.

export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v29.title: Export PDF Form Fields to JSON Using Aspose.Pdf Form Facade
export-pdf-form-fields-to-json__v29.description: Shows how to bind a PDF form, import XML data into it, and export the populated form fields to a JSON file with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.Form.

fill-acroform-template-from-datatable.title: Fill AcroForm Template from DataTable and Save Combined PDF
fill-acroform-template-from-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to bind an AcroForm PDF, import multiple DataTable rows with case‑matching field names using AutoFiller, and save the result as a single combined PDF.

fill-pdf-acroform-from-datatable.title: Fill PDF AcroForm from DataTable using AutoFiller
fill-pdf-acroform-from-datatable.description: Demonstrates binding a PDF template to Aspose.Pdf.Facades.AutoFiller, importing field values from a DataTable, and saving the populated PDF.

bind-acroform-pdf-fill-datatable.title: Bind AcroForm PDF and Fill Using DataTable
bind-acroform-pdf-fill-datatable.description: Shows how to bind a loaded AcroForm PDF to the AutoFiller facade, import a DataTable whose column names match form fields, and save the populated PDF.

fill-acroform-from-datatable.title: Fill AcroForm Template from DataTable and Save to PDF
fill-acroform-from-datatable.description: Shows how to bind an AcroForm PDF template, import field values from a synthetic DataTable using AutoFiller, and write the filled PDF to a file via a MemoryStream.

fill-pdf-form-from-datatable-using-autof.title: Fill PDF Form from DataTable using AutoFiller and MemoryStreams
fill-pdf-form-from-datatable-using-autof.description: Demonstrates creating a PDF form in memory, populating it from a DataTable with AutoFiller, and saving the filled document to both a MemoryStream and a local file.

fill-pdf-acroform-using-datatable.title: Fill PDF AcroForm Using DataTable with Column Mapping
fill-pdf-acroform-using-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to rename DataTable columns to match AcroForm field names and populate a PDF form using Aspose.Pdf's AutoFiller.

fill-pdf-form-merge-combined-pdf.title: Fill PDF Form with DataTable and Merge into Combined PDF
fill-pdf-form-merge-combined-pdf.description: Demonstrates creating a DataTable that matches PDF form fields, using AutoFiller to populate a template for each record, and merging the filled PDFs into a single combined document.

fill-acroform-from-datatable__v2.title: Fill AcroForm from DataTable with Date and Decimal Formatting
fill-acroform-from-datatable__v2.description: Demonstrates creating a synthetic DataTable with explicit date and decimal string formatting, importing it into an AcroForm using AutoFiller, and saving the filled PDF.

fill-pdf-acroform-from-datatable-keep-fi.title: Fill PDF AcroForm from DataTable While Keeping Selected Fields Editable
fill-pdf-acroform-from-datatable-keep-fi.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's AutoFiller to populate an AcroForm from a synthetic DataTable and specifying fields that should remain editable after saving the PDF.

fill-pdf-form-multiple-datasets-combine.title: Fill PDF Form from Multiple DataTables and Combine PDFs
fill-pdf-form-multiple-datasets-combine.description: Demonstrates populating a PDF form template with several independent DataTables using a fresh AutoFiller for each set, saving the filled PDFs, and merging them into a single document with PdfFileEditor.

fill-pdf-form-from-datatable.title: Fill PDF Form from Matching DataTable Columns
fill-pdf-form-from-datatable.description: Demonstrates how to compare a DataTable's column names with PDF form field names, copy only matching data, and populate the AcroForm fields programmatically before saving the filled PDF.
